requiredScope: The fixed grammar and construction obligations remain in force.

Expression/TextLiteral.structure: One immutable PHP string storing decoded UTF-8 bytes.
Expression/TextLiteral.conditions: Accept all well-formed UTF-8 byte sequences without U+0000. The owning SELECT supplies the type of an otherwise unknown simple output literal. An explicit cast is admitted when its scalar target is exactly built-in text and the operand is a string constant.
Expression/TextLiteral.meaning: The text value is the original sequence of decoded bytes, including empty strings, whitespace, backslashes and quotes. Compose it with the registered projection and same-type compound roles.
Expression/TextLiteral.sql: Quote with doubled single quotes under the fixed standard string setting and cast the value explicitly to pg_catalog.text.

externalInterpretation: Both sides use the same UTF-8 PostgreSQL profile and external input rows. The native result type is text.
observations: Exact UTF-8 values, including combining and supplementary code points, leading and trailing whitespace, empty strings and line endings
Text metadata and exact, ordered result labels
Rows from ordinary sources retain duplicates and have the same constant value per row
Compatible explicitly typed text compound arms retain text metadata

finite.completeness: Recover all dimensions from the actual published graph. Require each finite identity once on both releases.

exploration.requiredForms: Vary Unicode scalar values, quote placement, controls, labels, operand count and presence of duplicate input rows.

analysis: A standalone unaliased string is resolved to text and retains the native default result name.
A plain quoted string decodes two adjacent apostrophes.
A bare standard string retains a literal backslash.
A backslash-escape string preserves decoded newline and tab.
A dollar-quoted character value preserves quotes, newlines and backslash.
A Unicode escape string yields the expected supplementary characters.
A continued standard string adds its second segment without a separator.
The exact built-in text cast resolves a quote-bearing string.
An annotated text literal is replayed across distinct source rows and duplicates.
Two explicitly typed text operands of a UNION ALL retain native text metadata.
negative: An offered direct byte sequence contains U+0000.
An offered direct byte sequence contains invalid UTF-8.
An explicitly typed text set operand cannot unify with a native integer field.
faults: Return the empty string in place of a nonempty text value.
Remove a backslash from the decoded value.

evidence.P01: Check exact typed fields and decoded values from complete statements.
evidence.P02: Check validity of the byte sequence and the resolved consumer roles.
evidence.P03: Retain only the decoded value in the literal.
evidence.P04: Compose projection and same-type set operands with the checked text role.
evidence.P05: Connect the readonly type and its construction and storage checks to installed code.
evidence.P06: Compare typed results of original and emitted SQL on both releases.
evidence.Q01: Require typed boundary rejections for invalid bytes and type disagreement.
evidence.Q02: Require all finite identities, seeds and supported spellings.
evidence.Q03: Compare composite projection and compatible typed set behavior.
evidence.Q04: Use independent byte comparisons and exact result metadata.
evidence.Q05: Record and replay exact PHP source, controller and runtime identities.

open: Context-dependent implicit conversion of untyped literals in compound operands, mutation assignments, comparisons and other typed operands remains a distinct obligation.
Additional character types, typed NULL, nonstandard string settings and non-UTF-8 profiles require separate evidence.
trust: Immutable text role and explicit native text type
Pinned PostgreSQL lexical and SELECT output conversion rules
